title: AgriDefend: A $205 Offline Edge Device that Detects Crop Stress Before Visible Symptoms via Multimodal AI Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.34861v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most in-field crop-monitoring devices sense a single modality -- either a camera looking at the canopy or a probe reading the soil -- and so cannot detect stress that begins below ground before it becomes visible above it. We present AgriDefend, a self-contained consumer-grade edge device that fuses both. A MobileNetV2 convolutional neural network (CNN) analyses canopy imagery, and a Random Forest classifier integrates trend features from a single soil probe: moisture, the rate of change in pH and in N, P, K, and belowground CO2 relative to ambient (a proxy for soil respiration). A logistic-regression meta-learner fuses the two into a five-class crop-health prediction, all on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no cloud or cellular link. On a controlled greenhouse drought trial with wild radish, the fused model reached 87% accuracy (R^2=0.88, MAE=0.05) at 1.4 s INT8 TensorFlow Lite inference, and its soil signals preceded visible wilting by about four

translated_title: AgriDefend：一款售价205美元、通过多模态AI融合在可见症状出现前检测作物胁迫的离线边缘设备
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34861v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大多数田间作物监测设备仅感知单一模态——要么是观测冠层的相机，要么是读取土壤的探针——因此无法检测到始于地下、尚未在地上显现的胁迫。我们提出了AgriDefend，一种融合两种模态的自包含消费级边缘设备。MobileNetV2卷积神经网络（CNN）分析冠层图像，随机森林分类器整合来自单个土壤探针的趋势特征：土壤湿度、pH值以及氮、磷、钾的变化率，以及地下CO2相对于环境的水平（作为土壤呼吸的代理指标）。一个逻辑回归元学习器将两者融合为五类作物健康预测，全部在树莓派5上运行，无需云端或蜂窝网络连接。在一项针对野生萝卜的受控温室干旱试验中，融合模型达到87%的准确率（R²=0.88，MAE=0.05），INT8 TensorFlow Lite推理耗时1.4秒，且其土壤信号比可见萎蔫症状提前约四（天出现，原文在此处截断）。
tldr: AgriDefend是一款售价仅205美元的离线边缘设备，通过在树莓派5上融合冠层图像分析与土壤探针趋势数据的多模态AI，能够在肉眼可见症状出现前检测作物胁迫，准确率达87%。
en_tdlr: AgriDefend is a $205 offline edge device that fuses canopy imagery and soil probe data via multimodal AI on a Raspberry Pi 5, detecting crop stress before visible symptoms with 87% accuracy.
